name: Twinflame
oracle_text:
Strive — This spell costs {2}{R} more to cast for each target beyond the first.
Choose any number of target creatures you control. For each of them, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it has haste. Exile those tokens at the beginning of the next end step.
blocked_sentences: Choose any number of target creatures you control. For each of them, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it has haste. Exile those tokens at the beginning of the next end step

needs.what: copy_permanent's `except_` honouring `add_keywords` (707.9b): "create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it has haste" writes haste into the token's copiable values, so the token has haste as part of what it is and any later copy of the token also has haste
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_permanent's except_ is checked against loader.effects.COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS (colors, types, power, toughness, add_types, add_subtypes, add_supertypes, remove_supertypes, no_mana_cost), so add_keywords on copy_permanent is refused at load, and characteristics._compute never reads keywords from copy_overrides. The new become_copy except_ (add_keywords/keep_abilities, BECOME_COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS) writes obj.copying_keywords, but become_copy turns an existing permanent into a copy; it creates no token, so it cannot say "create a token that's a copy of that creature". The as-enters path (ENTERS_COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS, Dack's Duplicate) is likewise for the card itself entering. The pool's workaround for "that token gains haste" (Helm of the Host, Rionya) is a following grant_keyword with duration permanent, which is a granted effect rather than a copiable value: a copy of a Twinflame token would lose the haste. The fix is probably small: accept add_keywords in COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS and have characteristics._compute add copy_overrides['add_keywords'] to the printed keywords (or set copying_keywords on the token). The rest of the card is expressible: strive "{2}{R}" with a count "any" creature-you-control target (as Call the Coppercoats), copy_permanent with `as`, and a delay at end_step exiling the binding (as Stormsplitter).
